Question: How does the 20-day cacao challenge work?
Answer:
FOR 20 DAYS, WE WILL MEET FOR A 60-MINUTE DAILY GROUP CALL AND SHARE A CUP OF CACAO.

This is a community event of connection, healing, and openness.

If you have been following us, you know there is a sacred calendar called the Cholq'ij (sacred calendar of life) and every day has a specific energy that carries us throughout the day and determines what will happen. In our challenge we will go through the 20 energies of the Cholq'ij, and every day we will explore each one through cacao.

As we mentioned, our teachers spent the last 15 years doing research and what they discovered will determine this Challenge...

Part of their research was dedicated to recipes, and they discovered there is a recipe for each nahual (energy of the Cholq'ij).

Let's look at an example: On the day that is carried by the energy of Ajaw Aj, you can mix cacao with chili to boost the healing of the nervous system. And since the energy of the day naturally activates that part of your body, the mix creates a powerful healing reaction.

Some days will heal the physical body, others will heal the emotions and mind, and others will help have a profound spiritual experience. 

The 20-Day Challenge will cover all of the days, we will recreate recipes the Mayans were using thousands of years ago, and get to know the true ancient uses of cacao.
